```{r message = FALSE, echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse); library(coda)

### Load models (main criterion: highest-ranked)

load_model <- function(f) { e <- new.env(); load(f, envir = e); get(ls(e)[1], envir = e) }

types <- c(Overall = "all", Bidens = "bidens", Buddleja = "buddleja",
             Cortaderia = "cortaderia", Oenothera = "oenothera", Paspalum = "paspalum",
             Reynoutria = "reynoutria", Robinia = "robinia")

models <- map(types, ~ load_model(file.path("../models/topn", paste0("m-", .x, ".Rdata"))))

### Model diagnostics

iwalk(models, ~ plot(.x$VCV, main = .y))
iwalk(models, ~ plot(.x$Sol, main = .y))

### Model summary

map(models, summary)

### Phylo signal http://www.mpcm-evolution.com/practice/online-practical-material-chapter-11/chapter-11-1-simple-model-mcmcglmm

map_dfr(models, function(m) {
  lambda <- coda::mcmc(as.numeric(m$VCV[, "animal"] / (m$VCV[, "animal"] + m$VCV[, "units"])))
  hpd <- coda::HPDinterval(lambda)
  tibble(lambda = round(mean(lambda), 2),
         min = round(hpd[, 1], 2),
         max = round(hpd[, 2], 2))
}, .id = "Model")

### Random effects

map(models, ~ summary(.x)$Gcovariances)
```
